no_nodes: Right-click the effect to add a node.
broken_file: The file could not be read, so it is open read-only:
renders_particles: Drawn on every particle of the emitter above it. Placement is added to each particle.
renders_once: Drawn once, where it stands. Put it under an emitter to draw it on every particle.
name: Name
rate_hint: How many particles appear per second.
burst_hint: How many particles are released at once when each loop starts.
duration_hint: Seconds the emitter keeps emitting. 0 means forever.
max_particles_hint: The emitter never has more particles alive than this.
max_step_hint: The longest simulation step in seconds. Smaller keeps fast particles and collisions accurate, at a cost.
shape_model_hint: Particles are born on the surface of this model in its bind pose, and leave it along the surface normal.
extents_hint: Half the width, height and depth of the box, in blocks.
line_end_hint: The point the line runs to from the node center.
angle_hint: Half the opening angle of the cone, in degrees.
thickness_hint: 0 puts particles on the surface only, 1 fills the whole volume.
speed_hint: Starting speed in blocks per second.
spawn_offset_hint: Added to the point the shape picked.
inherit_velocity_hint: How much of the effect own velocity a particle keeps, 0 to 1.
size_hint: In blocks. A curve, or an expression on p.progress, changes it over the particle life.
spin_hint: Angles in degrees. A camera-facing billboard only uses Z.
color_hint: A gradient is read over the lifetime unless another source is picked.
gravity_hint: Blocks per second squared, pulling down. Negative pulls up.
drag_hint: The share of speed lost per second, 0 to 1.
blend_opaque_hint: Covers whatever is behind. Alpha only cuts holes.
blend_blend_hint: Ordinary transparency: smoke, dust, clouds. Sorted by depth.
blend_additive_hint: Adds light: fire, sparks, magic. Bright on dark and nearly invisible on light.
blend_multiply_hint: Multiplies what is behind: shadows, stains, soot.
uv_hint: Which part of the texture is the sprite, from 0 to 1. The frame atlas is cut out of this region.
facing_axis_hint: In the space of the particles: the emitter for local particles, the world for world ones.
tint_hint: Multiplies the colour. On a particle it multiplies the particle colour; on a trail or beam a gradient runs from head to tail.
ribbon_width_hint: In blocks, read along the ribbon: p.progress is 0 at the head and 1 at the tail.
trail_lifetime_hint: Seconds a point of the trail stays behind.
trail_min_distance_hint: How far the head moves, in blocks, before the trail takes a new point.
tile_length_hint: Blocks of ribbon one copy of the texture covers.
beam_end_hint: Where the beam ends in the space of this node, when there is no target node.
beam_noise_hint: How far, in blocks, noise pushes the middle of the beam aside. The ends stay put.
beam_frequency_hint: Noise waves per block of beam.
uv_scroll_hint: Texture lengths per second the texture slides from start to end.
shader_plane_hint: namespace:path of shaders/core/path.json. Attributes: Position, UV0, InstanceCenter, InstanceRight, InstanceUp, InstanceColor, InstanceUv, InstanceLight. Samplers: Sampler0, Sampler2, SceneColor, SceneDepth.
shader_mesh_hint: namespace:path of shaders/core/path.json. Attributes: Position, UV0, Normal, InstanceX, InstanceY, InstanceZ, InstanceOrigin, InstanceColor, InstanceUv, InstanceLight. Samplers: Sampler0, Sampler2, SceneColor, SceneDepth.
shader_ribbon_hint: namespace:path of shaders/core/path.json. The vanilla particle format: Position, UV0, Color, UV2. Samplers: Sampler0, Sampler2, SceneColor, SceneDepth.
shader_post_hint: namespace:path of shaders/core/path.json, drawn over the whole screen. Attributes: Position, UV0. Samplers: SceneColor, SceneDepth. ScreenSize is the size of the frame.
shader_missing: No such shader: the json is looked for in assets/namespace/shaders/core/path.json.
uniforms_stale: The file holds values for uniforms this shader does not declare:
shake_strength_hint: Multiplies the swing. An expression such as 1 - n.camera_distance / 24 fades it with distance.
shake_amplitude_hint: The widest swing in degrees: pitch, yaw and roll.
timeline_duration_hint: Length of the effect timeline in seconds.
expression_hint: p. is the particle, e. the emitter, n. the node, d. server data, math. the functions.
curve_open: Click to open the curve editor
driven_hint: Timeline keys set this value. Remove the keys to edit it here.
driven_show: Show the track on the timeline
module_unknown: This module comes from an addon that is not loaded. It is kept as it is.
velocity_hint: Added to the particle motion without changing its own velocity.
force_strength_hint: Blocks per second squared; for braking, the share of speed per second. Negative pulls towards the center.
force_center_hint: A point in the emitter frame.
frequency_hint: Noise cells per block: higher is finer and more chaotic.
scroll_speed_hint: How fast the noise field itself moves.
octaves_hint: Extra layers of finer detail. Each one doubles the cost.
bounce_hint: The share of speed left after a bounce, 0 to 1.
friction_hint: The share of speed along the surface kept after touching it.
hit_radius_hint: The particle is treated as a sphere of this radius, in blocks.
lifetime_loss_hint: Seconds of life a particle loses on every hit.
uv_frames_hint: How many grid cells hold a frame, row by row. 0 means all of them.
cycles_hint: How many times the atlas plays over the particle life.
beam_target_hint: The node the beam ends at. Leave empty to end it at the point below.
